Class Dsl

java.lang.Object
forj.http.Dsl
public final class Dsl extends Object
The routing DSL: import static forj.http.Dsl.*; then 
Path1<Long> user = Path.of("/users").then(LongVar);
Routes<IO> routes = Routes.of(
    GET("/health").respond(req -> Ok("up")),
    GET(user).to((req, id) -> repo.find(id).map(u -> Ok(u))));
Handlers come in two named forms, never overloads (Java can't pick between overloads of implicitly typed lambdas by what they return):
  • to(...): the handler returns an F<Response>;
  • respond(...): it returns a plain Response, lifted into F.
The handler receives the request, then the path's typed values in order.
